problem: Most VLN-CE methods represent a viewpoint using only current-step observation features, which mix redundant and navigation-relevant information and make action prediction ambiguous.
motivation: Better viewpoint representations should improve low-level action prediction in continuous environments. The paper proposes augmenting current observations with retrieved external knowledge and episode history, filtered by the instruction.
key_idea: Build instruction-tailored viewpoint representations by fusing current image features with retrieved knowledge-base features and navigation history, after filtering out instruction-irrelevant information.
insight: Only the abstract was available, so no ablations can be cited. The abstract implies that filtering knowledge and history against the instruction before fusion is what removes ambiguity from the viewpoint representation.
method: Current observation encoding: extracts image features from the current observation.
Knowledge retrieval: retrieves relevant knowledge from a knowledge base for the current view.
History acquisition: obtains features of the navigation history of the episode.
Instruction-guided filtering: filters knowledge and history features to remove information irrelevant to the instruction.
Instruction interaction and aggregation: integrates the refined features with the instruction, then uses the aggregated features to guide navigation.

setting.observation: not specified (abstract only; likely egocentric RGB-D in VLN-CE)
